num_days: <int> Total number of days in the planning horizon.
num_weeks: <int> Total number of complete weeks in the planning horizon.
num_nurses: <int> Total number of nurses available for scheduling.
num_shift_types: <int> Total number of distinct shift types that can be assigned.
num_weekends: <int> Total number of weekends in the planning horizon.

shift_types.id: <int> Unique identifier for this shift type.
shift_types.name: <str> Descriptive name of this shift type.
shift_types.length_minutes: <int> Duration of this shift type in minutes.

forbidden_shift_rotations.shift_type: <int> Shift type that, when assigned on a day, restricts the next day's assignment.
forbidden_shift_rotations.cannot_be_followed_by: <int> Shift type that may not be assigned on the day immediately following the preceding shift type.

nurses.max_shifts_per_type: <dict, key: '{shift_type_id}'> Maximum number of shifts of each type this nurse may work over the planning horizon.
nurses.min_total_minutes: <int> Minimum total working time in minutes this nurse must accumulate over the planning horizon.
nurses.max_total_minutes: <int> Maximum total working time in minutes this nurse may accumulate over the planning horizon.
nurses.min_consecutive_shifts: <int> Minimum number of consecutive working days allowed in any unbroken stretch of working days for this nurse.
nurses.max_consecutive_shifts: <int> Maximum number of consecutive working days allowed in any unbroken stretch of working days for this nurse.
nurses.min_consecutive_days_off: <int> Minimum number of consecutive days off allowed in any unbroken stretch of off-days for this nurse.
nurses.max_weekends: <int> Maximum number of weekends this nurse may work over the planning horizon.
nurses.day_off_requests: <list[int], length varies> Days on which this nurse must not be assigned any shift.

shift_on_requests.nurse_id: <int> Nurse for whom this shift-on request applies.
shift_on_requests.day: <int> Day on which the requested shift assignment is desired.
shift_on_requests.shift_type: <int> Shift type that is requested to be assigned.
shift_on_requests.penalty: <int> Penalty incurred if this nurse is not assigned the requested shift type on the specified day.

shift_off_requests.nurse_id: <int> Nurse for whom this shift-off request applies.
shift_off_requests.day: <int> Day on which the nurse prefers not to work the specified shift.
shift_off_requests.shift_type: <int> Shift type that the nurse prefers not to be assigned.
shift_off_requests.penalty: <int> Penalty incurred if this nurse is assigned the specified shift type on the specified day.

coverage_requirements.day: <int> Day to which this staffing requirement applies.
coverage_requirements.shift_type: <int> Shift type to which this staffing requirement applies.
coverage_requirements.preferred: <int> Preferred number of nurses to be assigned this shift type on this day.
coverage_requirements.under_weight: <int> Penalty weight per nurse below the preferred staffing level for this day and shift type.
coverage_requirements.over_weight: <int> Penalty weight per nurse above the preferred staffing level for this day and shift type.
